CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Car fire - the driver is out but needs help. Respond quickly.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Vehicle fire nearby, the driver is out but needs help. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the driver.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the driver.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the driver now.

OnSceneTextVariants.string: You made it. Let's get the driver checked out.
There's the driver, safe from the car. Let's check on them.
On scene - let's make sure the driver is okay.

CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the driver.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the driver.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Moving the driver to safety and checking them...

TreatingTextVariants.string: Getting them further from the fire and checking them...
Making sure they're safe and looking them over...
Checking them over well clear of the fire...

PatientThanksTextVariants.string: Thanks for getting me clear of that!
That was scary, thanks for the help!
I'm just glad to be safe, thank you!

CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The driver is safe now.

Injury.DispatchText: Car fire - the driver got out and is just a bit shaken.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Vehicle fire nearby, the driver is shaken but okay. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Driver
DialogueLine.Text: I got out okay, just a bit shaken up.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Come away from the car with me - you're safe now.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! The driver is safe and calm, well away from the car.

Injury.DispatchText: Car fire - the driver is coughing from the smoke.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Vehicle fire nearby, the driver is coughing from smoke. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Driver
DialogueLine.Text: I breathed some smoke getting out, I'm coughing a lot.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let's get you clear and on some oxygen.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - driver's away from the fire and breathing easy.

Injury.DispatchText: Car fire - the driver is hurt and needs the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. Vehicle fire nearby, the driver is hurt. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Driver
DialogueLine.Text: My arm's burnt and I feel really faint...

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: I've got you - away from the car, the ambulance is coming for you.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The driver is safely taken to the hospital for care.
